sourceArticle.title: Sencho Might Be the Docker Compose Management Tool Home Labs Have Been Waiting For
sourceArticle.author: Brandon Lee

athenaOutput.directive: Establish Sencho as the foundational, self-healing orchestration layer for sovereign local agentic networks, eliminating human infrastructure management entirely.
athenaOutput.rationale: To achieve true sovereignty (Article I) and zero human wait time (Article XX), our local infrastructure must be self-configuring, self-healing, and highly optimized. Integrating a modern Docker Compose manager like Sencho provides a clean, API-driven abstraction layer that our agents can programmatically manipulate, turning raw home lab hardware into an autonomous, sovereign cloud.

options.title: Autonomous Self-Healing Agent Mesh
options.description: Deploy a continuous agent loop (BOLT and AURORA) that interacts with Sencho's API to autonomously monitor, scale, and self-heal local service stacks. If a service fails or telemetry leaks are detected, the agent hot-patches the Compose file and redeploys via Sencho.
options.tradeoffs: Requires complex state-machine validation to prevent infinite restart loops, but completely eliminates human operational overhead (Article XX).

options.title: Sovereign Host Core Integration
options.description: Bake Sencho deeply into the Creative Liberation Engine OS as the default local container orchestrator, replacing raw Docker Compose. All system services and agent runtimes are managed as Sencho stacks out-of-the-box.
options.tradeoffs: Creates a strong dependency on Sencho's lifecycle and feature set, but provides an exceptionally clean, unified dashboard and API for local resource management.

options.title: Ambient Synth Multi-Node Mesh
options.description: Extend Sencho's single-node paradigm by building a custom synchronization layer that orchestrates decentralized Small Language Models (SLMs) across multiple physical home lab nodes using Sencho's API on each node.
options.tradeoffs: Introduces network consensus and state synchronization challenges, but scales local sovereign computing power seamlessly across cheap, distributed hardware.

options.title: Sovereign Blueprint Engine
options.description: Develop a curated, cryptographically signed library of production-grade, hardened Docker Compose blueprints optimized for Sencho. These blueprints guarantee zero external telemetry, built-in local TLS, and automatic backups.
options.tradeoffs: High initial curation and maintenance overhead, but guarantees complete, non-MVP implementations (Article IV) for every deployed service.

options.title: Sovereign Sentinel Compliance Shield
options.description: Integrate LEX and COMPASS compliance agents directly into the Sencho deployment pipeline. Every compose stack must pass automated static analysis for security vulnerabilities, open ports, and data leakage before Sencho is permitted to deploy it.
options.tradeoffs: Slightly increases deployment latency, but ensures absolute security and compliance in hostile local network environments.

constitutionalFlags: Article XX: Zero human wait time
